messages.author: 9ec69ca07f36d6a1
messages.subject: Strange carryover of caption
parts:
In knitr 1.5 I've getting an earlier caption to carry over to the last plot when the last plot is not supposed to have a caption.  Here's my code.  Any help appreciated.  Thanks -Frank

Main file: test5.Rnw

\documentclass{article}
\begin{document}
<<>>=
render_listings()
unlink('messages.txt') # Start fresh with each run
hook_log = function(x, options) cat(x, file='messages.txt', append=TRUE)
knit_hooks$set(warning = hook_log, message = hook_log)
opts_knit$set(
    aliases=c(h='fig.height', w='fig.width', cap='fig.cap', scap='fig.scap'),
    eval.after = c('fig.cap','fig.scap'),
    error=FALSE, keep.source=TRUE)
  opts_chunk$set(w=5, h=3)
  
prefix <- 'elephant'
@ 
<<example,child='child.Rnw',cap='Caption from master',h=4>>=
@ 
<<echo=FALSE,eval=FALSE>>=
x <- y! + 3
xx - * 13 (
z <-
@

\Sexpr{knit(text=knit_expand('macro.Rnw'))}

\end{document}


child.Rnw

This is a \LaTeX\ sentence inside child.Rnw.
<<this,h=2,w=6>>=
plot(runif(200))
@
A sentence outside the R chunk.
<<that,fig.cap='Another caption'>>=
hist(rnorm(1000),nclass=50)
@ 
End of second child chunk.

macro.Rnw

\section{Junk}
<<{{prefix}}-a>>=
x3 <- pi
print(x3)
plot(runif(5), main="{{prefix}}")
@

messages.author: cc1ef8c8158d6b73
messages.subject: Re: [knitr] Strange carryover of caption
parts:
It is easy to fix: just change fig.cap to cap in child.Rnw.

The reason for that is the aliases take precedence over the original
option names. In other words, if you provided both cap and fig.cap,
cap will be used.

BTW, in opts_knit$set(), the options error=FALSE and keep.source=TRUE
are not used. keep.source is not an option in knitr, and error is an
option opts_chunk$set(). Besides, in the current CRAN version of
knitr, you can actually write messages and warnings on screen using
opts_chunk$set(message=FALSE, warning=FALSE), if you do not really
prefer these messages to be in a file. But a log file is certainly
better if you want to take a look at it later.

Regards,
Yihui

instead of the .tex file. Did you run update.packages()? In
particular, you probably need to update the evaluate package. If you
believe everything is up-to-date, please send the session info:

sessionInfo()

Here's my whole knitr setup function:

knitrSet <- function(basename=NULL, w=4, h=3,
                     fig.align='center', fig.show='hold', fig.pos='htbp',
                     fig.lp=paste('fig', basename, sep=':'), dev='pdf',
                     tidy=FALSE, error=FALSE, messages=c('messages.txt','tex'),
                     width=61, decinline=5, cache=FALSE,
                     echo=TRUE) {
  messages <- match.arg(messages)
  ## Specify dev=c('pdf','png') to produce two graphics files for each plot
  ## But: dev='CairoPNG' is preferred for png
  if(length(basename)) basename <- paste(basename, '-', sep='')

  options(width=width)
  ## fills Sweavel boxes when font size is \small and svmono.cls
  ## is in effect (use 65 without svmono)

  render_listings()
  if(messages != 'tex') {
unlink(messages) # Start fresh with each run
hook_log = function(x, options) cat(x, file=messages, append=TRUE)

knit_hooks$set(warning = hook_log, message = hook_log)
  }

else opts_chunk$set(message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)
  if(length(decinline)) {
    rnd <- function(x, dec) if(!is.numeric(x)) x else round(x, dec)
    formals(rnd) <- list(x=NULL, dec=decinline)
    knit_hooks$set(inline = rnd)
  }
  knit_hooks$set(par=function(before, options, envir)
                 if(before && options$fig.show != 'none') {
                   p <- c('bty','mfrow','ps','bot','top','left','rt','lwd',
                          'mgp','tcl', 'axes','xpd')
                   pars <- opts_current$get(p)
                   pars <- pars[!is.na(names(pars))]
                   if(length(pars)) do.call('spar', pars) else spar()
                 })
  opts_knit$set(
    aliases=c(h='fig.height', w='fig.width', cap='fig.cap', scap='fig.scap'))
    #eval.after = c('fig.cap','fig.scap'),
    #error=error)  #, keep.source=keep.source (TRUE))
  opts_chunk$set(fig.path=basename, fig.align=fig.align, w=w, h=h,
                 fig.show=fig.show, fig.lp=fig.lp, fig.pos=fig.pos,
                 dev=dev, par=TRUE, tidy=tidy, out.width=NULL, cache=cache,
                 echo=echo, error=error)
  hook_chunk = knit_hooks$get('chunk')
  ## centering will not allow too-wide figures to go into left margin
  knit_hooks$set(chunk = function(x, options) { 
    res = hook_chunk(x, options) 
    if (options$fig.align != 'center') return(res) 
    gsub('\\{\\\\centering (\\\\includegraphics.+)\n\n\\}', 
         '\\\\centerline{\\1}', res) 
  }) 
}

Frank
